# Powai Smile Care

> Dental clinic in Powai, Mumbai (PIN 400076). Boutique specialist care: single-sitting root canals, implants, zirconia crowns and clear aligners. See every price before you book.

## Who we are
Powai Smile Care is a Dental clinic in Powai, Mumbai. Ground-floor access with parking. 5 minutes from Powai Lake and 10 minutes from SEEPZ. Landmark: Lake View Plaza, opposite Powai Lake.
Treatments are led by Dr. Aarav Joshi, BDS, MDS (Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics).

## FAQ (short answers)
Q: Is a root canal completed in a single sitting without pain?
A: Yes. Over 90% of routine cases finish in one 45–60 minute sitting. Electronic apex locators and slow-infusion local anaesthesia keep the whole treatment painless.

Q: Do you take emergency walk-ins?
A: Yes. We keep same-day slots for throbbing toothache, abscess, broken crowns and dental trauma. Call or message us by morning and we will fit you in that day.

Q: Why a specialist clinic instead of a general dentist?
A: Complex work — implants, root canals, veneers — is done by MDS postgraduate specialists in each discipline, not general dentists. You get hospital-level specialist care.

Q: How long do implants take?
A: Usually 3–4 months and 2–3 visits. We confirm the timeline and a written cost before anything starts.

Q: Are zirconia crowns as strong as metal?
A: Yes. Monolithic zirconia is strong, has no dark line, and matches the translucency of natural teeth — the best of both worlds.

Q: Do clear aligners hurt?
A: You feel mild pressure for a few days after each tray change. Most patients adjust within a week and never need pain relief.
